title: Steam Introduces Achievement Sets for Base Games and DLCs
excerpt: Valve is rolling out achievement sets on Steam, allowing developers to group achievements separately for base games and downloadable content.
body_html:
Valve is introducing a major update to Steam achievements called achievement sets. This new feature allows game developers to organize achievements into different groups, separating them between the base game and downloaded content.

According to Valve, players will continue to unlock achievements through normal gameplay. However, when users review their unlocked progress, Steam will display the achievements organized by these specific sets.
